guarantees.claim: data_in_prev_sel_o is the bitwise OR of all mr_data_in_prev_sel[i] for i=0..Sp2VWidth-1 (zero if Sp2VWidth==0).
state_in_sel_o is the bitwise OR of all mr_state_in_sel[i] for i=0..Sp2VWidth-1.
add_state_in_sel_o is the bitwise OR of all mr_add_state_in_sel[i] for i=0..Sp2VWidth-1.
add_state_out_sel_o is the bitwise OR of all mr_add_state_out_sel[i] for i=0..Sp2VWidth-1.
key_init_sel_o is the bitwise OR of all mr_key_init_sel[i] for i=0..Sp2VWidth-1.
iv_sel_o is the bitwise OR of all mr_iv_sel[i] for i=0..Sp2VWidth-1.
mr_err is 1 if any mr_*_sel[i] differs from the corresponding combined OR output; otherwise 0.

assumptions.claim: All mr_*_sel inputs for a given select type must be identical across all i; otherwise the combined OR may produce an invalid select that could route AES critical data (key, IV, state) incorrectly.
assumptions.risk: mr_err flags inconsistently but does not block propagation; invalid selects may cause key/IV/state selection errors, potentially leaking secrets or breaking cipher operations.

uncertain_points.claim: mr_err is asserted but does not gate the output select signals; an erroneous OR-combination (e.g., multiple set bits from inconsistent inputs) can still be driven to downstream muxes, potentially selecting wrong AES data path (key, IV, state).
uncertain_points.cond: when any mr_*_sel[i] differs from the OR result
uncertain_points.risk: Uncontained fault: corrupted select may expose key material, initiate unintended encryption/decryption, or break state integrity before error handling intervenes.

uncertain_points.claim: The bitwise OR of potentially one-hot encoded mr_*_sel vectors can produce an invalid encoding (e.g., multiple bits set) if the inputs are inconsistent or not strictly one-hot. There is no local check to ensure the final select is a legal member of the enum.
uncertain_points.cond: when any mr_*_sel[i] has a different one-hot bit
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream muxes or case statements may not handle such illegal values, leading to Undefined behavior, wrong key/IV/state selection, or exposure of secrets.

uncertain_points.claim: mr_err is a combinational signal that may glitch if mr_*_sel inputs change asynchronously; downstream sampling could latch a transient false error.
uncertain_points.risk: Spurious error handling or logging that disrupts normal AES operation.
